# Original Markdown editing results

`java-golden.json` contains 30 results generated by `tests/java/MarkdownEditGolden.java`
against the unmodified original MarkdownEditorPane and its actual RichTextFX editor.
It runs in a separate JavaFX process with an isolated user.home, no saved
connections, no file saves and no clipboard calls. Runtime Rust code uses no Java.

Original MarkdownEditorPane.java SHA-256:
`1FDCEE4DB787755807188AF776E8B7AEA263DDD4082D28B747159CC24F709BF3`.
Fixture SHA-256:
`4A385CE447FCD87F609F955BE875460A452974048276D856A06E5EF977D83C6B`.

The original editor class and its Maven dependencies must be supplied on the
classpath to regenerate. The generator uses JDK 25 with --enable-preview and
the original JavaFX 27 dependencies. Compile it, then run MarkdownEditGolden
with the desired output JSON path. The oracle covers text and UTF-16 selection
offsets; it is not a full keyboard, IME, undo grouping or visual equivalence proof.
